name: [🌴] Grow a Jungle
desc:
🌴 Welcome to Grow A Jungle 🌴

Are you ready to grow your very own jungle? Buy tree seeds from the shop when they restock, plant them, wait for them to grow, and collect the drops! Flex plots and finds on friends, and have fun!

[🌺] TREES GROW OFFLINE

[🌱 How To Plant 🌱]
• Equip the tree seed you want to plant!
• Click in your farm on the green plots to plant!
• Wait to see it start growing!
• After its fully grown, harvest the goods!

[🛜📉] Does your device lag when playing? Create a FREE Private Server to boost your gameplay!
